name: opencode-goal-plugin
description: Persistent, evidence-checked goals for OpenCode. Adds the /goal slash command plus goal_create / goal_status / goal_update tools, so both you and the agent itself can drive long-running work until a verifiable stopping condition. Works in the TUI, the web and desktop apps, IDE extensions, ACP clients, opencode run, and any client built on the OpenCode API.

scripts.setup: bun run install:posix || bun run install:win
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
